title: Quibi Failure Postmortem
text: Quibi was a short-form streaming platform designed for mobile devices. Despite raising $1.75 billion, the company shut down just six months after its launch. The primary failure reasons included a lack of product-market fit, as users didn't find the short-form, premium content compelling enough to pay for. Additionally, launching during the COVID-19 pandemic severely impacted their core use case, which was watching content during commutes. High production costs and restrictive intellectual property deals further drained their runway, leading to an eventual pivot and shutdown.
